base: Percentage of enrolled students. Understanding: at least one report with overall level >= 3.
vacio: No concepts have been assessed yet.

integraciones.intro: Soon you'll be able to connect MuseLearn with the platform your school already uses: bring in your classes and students, and send back what each one understood.
integraciones.hoy: Meanwhile, students join each class with its 6-letter code.
integraciones.enlaceDetalle: See which learning platforms you'll be able to connect.

classroom.devolver: understanding as a private comment and grade

csv.devolver: a file with submissions and understanding, for any platform

integraciones.nota: We use each platform's standards (official APIs and LTI 1.3). Your school decides what gets connected.

classroom.intro: Bring your Classroom courses with their students and tasks. We only read; we don't change anything in your Classroom.
classroom.prueba: Test mode: Google will show an “unverified app” notice. That's normal until the app is published.
classroom.sinCursos: We found no active courses where you are a teacher.

resultado.inscritos: {n, plural, =0 {No new students enrolled} one {I enrolled 1 student} other {I enrolled # students}}.
resultado.yaEstaban: {n, plural, =0 {} one {1 was already there.} other {# were already there.}}
resultado.sinCuenta: {n, plural, one {1 student doesn't have a MuseLearn account yet} other {# students don't have a MuseLearn account yet}}. Share the class code with them:
resultado.tareas: {n, plural, =0 {There were no new tasks to import.} one {I imported 1 task.} other {I imported # tasks.}}
resultado.tareasYaEstaban: {n, plural, one {1 was already here.} other {# were already here.}}
resultado.tareasVencidas: {n, plural, one {1 overdue task was not imported.} other {# overdue tasks were not imported.}}
resultado.tareasLimite: {n, plural, one {1 task was left for the next import (daily limit).} other {# tasks were left for the next import (daily limit).}}
resultado.tareasPlan: Muse is fitting them into each student's week. They hand them in on Classroom; on MuseLearn they upload evidence and do the comprehension check.
resultado.tareasSinPermiso: To bring the tasks too, disconnect and reconnect Google Classroom (a new permission is needed).

errores.sin_configurar: Google is not configured on the server yet (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in Vercel).
errores.denegado: You didn't give MuseLearn permission in Google. You can try again.
errores.estado_invalido: The connection expired or is invalid. Connect again.
errores.google: Google Classroom didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
errores.sin_sesion: Sign in as a teacher to connect Classroom.
errores.no_tu_curso: You can only import courses where you are a teacher.
errores.error: It couldn't be completed. Please try again.

repaso.ayuda: Muse reads the class comprehension results (without student names) and suggests activities for your next class.
repaso.sinInformes: Once your students complete a task's comprehension check, Muse can suggest a review.
repaso.aviso: It's a suggestion: adapt it to your group.

errores.limite: You reached today's limit of AI help. Try again tomorrow.
errores.sinInformes: There are no comprehension reports in this class yet.
errores.general: The AI didn't respond. Try again in a moment.

general.conceptos: How the class is doing on each concept
general.conceptosAyuda: How many students are at each level, based on their latest report. Weakest concepts first.
general.apoyoAyuda: Students with concepts at Beginning or Developing, or with overdue tasks not handed in.
general.nadie: Nobody for now: the class is doing well!
general.sinEntregar: {n, plural, one {1 overdue task not handed in} other {# overdue tasks not handed in}}
